question: Does the box-bearing canonical train split represent the style-conditioned evidence distribution in canonical validation?
analysis_unit: Church. Multiple canonical-train views are averaged within church before every shift statistic or transfer evaluation.
primary_train_population: The same 90 box-bearing train churches used by the local calibration artifact.
reference_control: All canonical-train churches versus validation in global CLIP space; this control is reported but is not a positive condition in the primary box-subset diagnosis.

representations.global: Frozen OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 normalized 224px image embedding
representations.local: PAT-B-260727-004 train-LOCO and validation official 8-anchor top-1%-patch score vectors

local_transfer_head: Frozen PAT-B-260727-005 class-balanced ridge multinomial head selected using train-only CV

permutation.scheme: Permute train/validation domain labels within each architectural style while preserving per-style split counts
permutation.statistic: Equal-style mean squared distance between split centroids

per_style_effect: Centroid distance divided by train within-style RMS radius
global_transfer: Within the 90 box-bearing train churches, leave-one-church-out prototype balanced accuracy versus box-subset-train-prototype validation balanced accuracy
local_transfer: Frozen head train out-of-fold balanced accuracy versus validation balanced accuracy
interpretation_boundary: A supported split-shift diagnosis does not prove the causal annotation-selection mechanism and does not authorize further adapter tuning on canonical validation.
